fact_text: Markets price a crisis mostly when its first wave hits, because uncertainty is highest then; later waves can be more dangerous on the ground but usually move prices less.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSX Falls 6,400 Points & Oil $90 | My Strategy After the Big Drop?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In an oil shock, prices in the second wave have tended to stay below the initial peak, because supply responses such as rerouted exports and cuts in buying by large importers cap the rise.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSX Falls 6,400 Points & Oil $90 | My Strategy After the Big Drop?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The Strait of Hormuz is the key chokepoint for seaborne oil, so disruption to shipping through it feeds directly into global oil prices and then into markets such as PSX.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSX Falls 6,400 Points & Oil $90 | My Strategy After the Big Drop?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Saudi Arabia can route crude through its East-West pipeline to bypass the Strait of Hormuz, which limits how far a Hormuz disruption can push oil prices.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSX Falls 6,400 Points & Oil $90 | My Strategy After the Big Drop?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PSX has recently tracked oil prices closely, so a sharp oil rise tends to produce an index correction, which the analyst expected to ease if the oil move is a secondary shock.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSX Falls 6,400 Points & Oil $90 | My Strategy After the Big Drop?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Strong FX reserves reduce the risk of rupee devaluation during an external oil shock, because the reserves are not under heavy pressure.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSX Falls 6,400 Points & Oil $90 | My Strategy After the Big Drop?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Mutual fund redemptions force those funds to sell, while banks and insurance companies tend to be longer-term buyers, so a shift from fund selling to bank and insurer buying shows shares moving from weak hands to stronger ones.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSX Falls 6,400 Points & Oil $90 | My Strategy After the Big Drop?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: During a conflict, a mediation headline or an announced return to negotiations can spark a short-term relief rally on PSX, which the analyst expects to fade if the conflict continues.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSX Falls 6,400 Points & Oil $90 | My Strategy After the Big Drop?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Investors who check prices every day react strongly to small index moves that look dramatic in points, while the same percentage fall in a physical asset would be ignored; value investors use that panic to buy better companies cheaply.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'PSX Falls 6,400 Points & Oil $90 | My Strategy After the Big Drop?' (YouTube transcript, undated)
